about.text: Symplectic geometry studies manifolds equipped with a closed, non-degenerate two-form, the structure behind Hamiltonian mechanics. This course covers the mathematical side of the subject and builds up to a proof of the Darboux theorem: a review of differential geometry (vector fields, flows and differential forms), symplectic linear algebra, symplectic manifolds, and the Darboux theorem. It is suitable for both undergraduate and graduate students.
